preconditions.description: The number of rooms N is between 1 and 30000 inclusive.
The number of gates M is between 1 and 200000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= N and 1 <= q <= N for p, q in V)
preconditions.description: Each gate connects two rooms, both of which are within the range from 1 to N inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len([room for room in range(1, N+1) if all(room in reachable_rooms for reachable_rooms in all_reachable_rooms)])
postconditions.description: The return value is the number of rooms that are reachable from every other room in the maze.
